violations.why: After disabling all interrupts, the main task re‑enables only interrupt 1. irq_walnut can pre‑empt the task between line 22 and line 39 and increments v_garnet, so the read at line 39 may see a value modified by the ISR.
irq_walnut can pre‑empt the main task, enable interrupt 2, and then be pre‑empted by irq_dune. The write to v_garnet in irq_dune can occur between the two main‑task accesses.
After the read at line 39 the main task still has interrupt 1 enabled, so irq_walnut may fire before the write at line 40, inserting a write between the read and the subsequent write.
